# ── Who we are ─────────────────────────────────────────────
> Rajyashree Construction LLP is a premium residential and
> commercial real-estate developer based in Pune, Maharashtra,
> India. Founded in 1999, the company has over 10 years of
> active project experience and has developed more than
> 25 Lac sq.ft of residential and commercial space across Pune.
> The company is known for on-time delivery and RERA-compliant
> projects.

# ── Active projects ──────────────────────────────────────────

## Rajyashree Nandanvan
- URL: https://www.rajyashreeconstruction.com/project/nandanvan
- Location: Bhilarewadi, Pune, Maharashtra
- Type: Residential
- Configuration: 2 BHK and 3 BHK apartments
- Area: 1000 to 1600 sq.ft
- Total units: 650+ premium units
- Floors: G + 23
- Status: Ongoing
- Possession: December 2030
- RERA: PS2100024059 (verify at maharera.mahaonline.gov.in)
- Price range: ₹55 lakh to ₹1.2 Crore (contact for current pricing)
- Key amenities: Infinity swimming pool, rooftop sky lounge, gymnasium,
  children's play area, landscaped gardens, EV charging stations,
  jogging track, meditation pavilion, 24/7 security

## Rajyashree Greenview Heights
- URL: https://www.rajyashreeconstruction.com/project/greenview-heights
- Location: Baner, Pune, Maharashtra
- Type: Residential
- Configuration: 2 BHK and 3 BHK apartments
- Area: 1200 to 2100 sq.ft
- Total units: 72 units
- Floors: G + 10
- Status: Upcoming
- Possession: June 2025
- Key amenities: Swimming pool, gymnasium, clubhouse, children's play area,
  landscaped garden, covered parking, solar power, CCTV security
